assertion_results.text: Investigation identifies the trailing-whitespace heading extraction as the root cause -- line[3:] does not strip whitespace (Steps 2-3)
assertion_results.evidence: investigation.md lines 27-30: 'Defect location: The extraction `line[3:]` captures everything after `## `, including any trailing whitespace. When the heading line in the file is `## Migration Patterns  \n`, the extracted `section_name` becomes `"Migration Patterns  "` (with two trailing spaces).' Line 74: 'Issue: Missing `.strip()` (or `.rstrip()`) call on the extracted heading text.'

assertion_results.text: Root cause comment includes: what is broken (heading extraction does not strip trailing whitespace), where it is broken (plan-feature convention lookup), and how to verify the fix (reproducer test with whitespace in heading) (Step 4)
assertion_results.evidence: root-cause.md -- What: lines 9-13 state 'extracts CONVENTIONS.md section headings using line[3:], which captures everything after the ## prefix without stripping trailing whitespace'. Where: lines 22-27 identify 'plugins/sdlc-workflow/skills/plan-feature/SKILL.md -- convention conformance analysis section, specifically the heading extraction logic'. How to verify: lines 44-57 describe reproducer strategy including 'Create a CONVENTIONS.md fixture with trailing whitespace on at least one section heading' and 'Assert that the extracted section name is Migration Patterns (without trailing whitespace)'.

assertion_results.text: Task description has reproducer test as the FIRST acceptance criterion -- before any fix criteria (Step 5 Acceptance Criteria ordering)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md line 73: First acceptance criterion is '- [ ] Reproducer test: a test with trailing whitespace on a CONVENTIONS.md section heading demonstrates the bug (fails before fix, passes after fix)'. Fix criteria follow on lines 74-76 (heading extraction strips whitespace, task enrichment matches, no regression).
